## Problem

What happened, and what did you expect?

## Reproduce it

Give the command or steps, Git commit, relevant configuration, and run ID if one exists. Include the smallest useful example. Remove tokens and private machine details before posting.

## Evidence and impact

Link the file, raw reading, source passage, test output, or screenshot. Explain whether the problem affects accuracy, energy accounting, timing, reproducibility, or only the workspace.

## Environment

State the operating system, relevant software versions, hardware, and measurement coverage when needed. Mark unknown values as unknown.

## Existing results

List results that may need another check. Keep old records; do not delete them to hide the problem.
